page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, with Hebrew headwords set large at the left of each entry. No marginal notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top right, catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: facit facultates maximè, si nimium imponatur, I.Reg.5.13. Plur. מסים Tributa, Exod.1.11. Et foem. מסי, unde Conftr. מס Deut.16.10. vel, Sufficientia, ex Chaldaica significatione: nam pro Hebraeo די vel ד, in Targum frequenter ponitur מסתי: ut, מסתי Sufficientia mea, Proverb.30.8.
תמס m. Liquefactio: שבלול תמס Limax liquefactionis, id est, liquescens, Pfalm.58.8.
מסר Tradidit, Suppeditavit: Infinit. למסר־מעל Ad suppeditandum praevaricationem, Num.31.16. Niph. Futur. וימסרו Et traditi sunt, Num.31.5.
מסרת f. Traditio, Exhibitio: Ezech.20.37. Sunt tamen ex Hebraeis, qui hoc ab אסר deducant, pro מאסרת Vinculum. Vide אסר.

מעד Vacillavit, Nutavit, Lapsus est: Praet. מעדו קרסלי Vacillant tali mei, 2.Sam.22.37. Partic. praesens, למועדי רגל Ad nutantes, vel, in nutationibus pedis, Job.12.5. Futur. לא אמעד Non vacillabo, Pfal.26.1. תמעד אשריו Labascit ullus greffuum ejus, Pfal.37.3. Pyh. juxta quosdam, est Partic. foemin. מועדת ורגל Et pes vacillare factus, Luxatus, Prov.25.19. Hiph.Imp. המעד Fac ut nutent, Pfalm.69.24.

מעה מעים m.d. Viscera: Conftruct. במעי הדג In visceribus pisci, Jon.2.1. Aff. מעיו Viscera ejus, 2.Sam.20.10. מעי Viscera mea, Jer.4.19. ומעיהם Et viscera sua, Ezech.7.19. in quibus irregulariter est Tzere sub Mem loco Scheva. Chaldaicè, מעוהי Venter ejus, Daniel.2.32. per Metonymiam. In Targum מעין, unde מעיהון Viscera sua, Ezech.7. verf.19. מעוהי Viscera sua, 2.Sam.20. v.10.
מעות f. Scrupi, Lapilli: Aff. במעותיו Sicut scrupi ejus, Jesa.48.19.

page.notes: Hebrew headwords and forms are transcribed from a low-resolution scan; the vowel points and the exact letters of the large headwords (מסר, מעד, מעה) are uncertain. Latin "Pfal." and "Pfalm." are kept as printed. Long s has been rendered as s. The first paragraph continues from the previous page. The faint marks in the left margin are not printed text and have not been transcribed.
